changelog:
Major v5.0 release with comprehensive upgrades for K12 teachers

- Full upgrade based on FeiFei Companion v4.0 with all previous features retained.
- Introduces six new teacher-exclusive modules: Teaching Workbench, Homework Correction Assistant, Parent-Communication Assistant, Academic Analysis System, Class Management Assistant, and Question Bank & Paper Composition.
- Integrates Tsinghua MAIC Virtual Classroom, ChinaTextbook Library, OCR grading, and WeChat parent communication.
- Enhanced trinity AI architecture, combining three specialized AI agents for holistic teaching and learning support.
- Supports both Chinese and English, with expanded personalization and proactive AI capabilities.
